title: The Search for the Perfect Door - Deviant Ollam
summary: Deviant Ollam shows that most physical attacks on doors bypass the lock, with photo and video examples of how doors, frames and hardware get defeated. It is a physical security talk from Shakacon.
why: HN recommends it as an interesting talk on how weak real-world door security is, and cites it for the stories of bad doors.

quote.text: Heard it recently and thought it was really interesting.
